coordinates.note: Geocoder (OpenStreetMap/Nominatim) point for the CERN Meyrin site; allowed for kind 'campus' under A17. precision_m 500 reflects that the site is an 80 ha campus, not a point. No official CERN page fetched in this session publishes WGS84 coordinates. The ROR record for CERN gives 46.20222 / 6.14569, which is the Geneva city centroid, ~8 km away, and was therefore not used.

name: CERN Meyrin site
notes: CERN's main site has been at Meyrin since 1954 (src:cern-meyrin-site-point-1: 'the location of its main site since 1954').

summary.plain: CERN's main campus, an 80-hectare site that straddles the Swiss-French border next to the village of Meyrin outside Geneva. Most of the laboratory's offices, workshops, computer centre and visitor buildings are here, and the ATLAS experiment sits underground at its edge.
summary.technical: Main CERN campus (surface), 80 ha across the Swiss communes of Meyrin and Satigny and the French communes of Prevessin-Moens and Saint-Genis-Pouilly; hosts Linac4, the PS Booster, the PS, the CERN Data Centre and LHC Point 1.
